name: xb_share_v1
description: Primary objective for the pm_xb_share_mult sweep: targets both sides of the diagnosed engine-shape defect in one objective -- total_bases_1plus is over-projected (avg_p=0.660 vs emp=0.574, essentially the hits-over-projection issue restated) while total_bases_4plus/5plus are under-projected (0.122 vs 0.152, 0.061 vs 0.070). xb_share_mult (default 0.94, dampened below neutral) directly controls the singles-vs-extra-base split on contact, so raising it should simultaneously improve both sides. hr_brier carried as a guardrail since HR already has its own promoted fix (hr_rate_mult=1.10) that this shouldn't quietly regress; totals MAE and starter pitches_bias as low-weight sanity terms.
